hotels.title: Boutique Snowy Mountains Alpine Villas near Jindabyne with One Breakfast Hamper
hotels.description: On the quiet edge of Jindabyne, with Thredbo and Perisher Valley within driving distance reach, Hamilton House is a Snowy Mountains retreat that's perfect year-round. Set across five acres of private land, this alpine escape feels roomy yet still tucked away, with a gated residence with boutique, self-contained villas paired with manicured grounds and sweeping native gardens. When you feel like socialising, visit the shared undercover cabana - complete with a BBQ, firepit and herb garden - and get to know your neighbours after a day of exploring the area, shopping in Jindabyne or savouring fresh produce and scintilating local spirits at Wildbrumby Distillery. Plus, you’re minutes away from Lake Jindabyne and close to hiking trails, mountain biking and horse riding. This is outdoor adventure that doesn't depend on the season.
